description: Intent i016 (SNAPSHOT=s04, branch=error-unwind-poisoned-count) complete with an evidence-backed negative result. The assigned tree drivers/usb was audited for early-return/failure/teardown paths that leave an untrusted count/length stored in a shared object (urb/request/skb/sgl/iovec/ring entry) that a later completion/cleanup loop iterates. The only complete chain present is the seed's own unpatched usbip code, excluded per the seed rule: usbip_common.c:392 stores the peer's rpdu->number_of_packets into urb->number_of_packets (usbip_pack_pdu RET_SUBMIT unpack); vhci_rx.c:80-85 returns early after usbip_recv_xbuff/usbip_recv_iso failure without resetting the count or calling usb_hcd_giveback_urb (URB leak at line 76/77); usbip_common.c:583-603 computes 'int size = np * sizeof(*iso)' and returns -EPIPE/-ENOMEM with the poisoned count intact, which completion paths iterate. Non-seed candidates examined and found safe: (1) drivers/usb/core/devio.c processcompl/compute_isochronous_actual_length loops at 1821-1858 are bounded because proc_urb_submit clamps uurb->number_of_packets to 1..128 at lines 1537-1538 before alloc_async allocates matching descriptors (1578, 1689); (2) drivers/usb/atm/usbatm.c rx loop at 529 uses a probe-time locally computed count (usb_alloc_urb(iso_packets) at 1141, urb->number_of_packets = iso_packets at 1145) and usbatm_complete's error path only throttles the tasklet, never poisons the count; (3) drivers/usb/misc/usbtest.c:1987 count comes from the same local used to allocate the URB; (4) drivers/usb/core/urb.c usb_submit_urb re-validates count>0 and per-descriptor lengths (448-457). Limitations: sweep bounded to drivers/usb and urb-centric fields; net/fs io_uring/scsi-sgl/vhost-ring/gadget request teardown paths not individually audited; per-HCD iso completion loops (ehci-sched, uhci-q, xhci num_tds, fotg210, imx21, isp1362, r8a66597) located via grep but only sampled.
